parameters.query: SELECT id, name, status, candidate_name, client_name, target_region, created_at FROM campaigns WHERE is_active = true ORDER BY created_at DESC

=SELECT m.*, me.name AS entity_name, me.entity_type FROM mentions m LEFT JOIN monitored_entities me ON me.id = m.entity_id WHERE m.campaign_id = '{{ $('Loop por Campanha').item.json.id }}' AND m.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' ORDER BY m.created_at DESC LIMIT 500

=SELECT m.id, m.entity_id, m.source, m.sentiment, m.created_at, m.metadata, me.name AS entity_name, me.entity_type FROM mentions m LEFT JOIN monitored_entities me ON me.id = m.entity_id WHERE m.campaign_id = '{{ $('Loop por Campanha').item.json.id }}' AND m.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY m.created_at DESC LIMIT 1500

=SELECT id, type, title, description, severity, created_at FROM alerts WHERE campaign_id = '{{ $('Loop por Campanha').item.json.id }}' AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50
=SELECT id, name, entity_type, is_active FROM monitored_entities WHERE campaign_id = '{{ $('Loop por Campanha').item.json.id }}' AND is_active = true ORDER BY entity_type
=SELECT * FROM intelligence_snapshots WHERE campaign_id = '{{ $('Loop por Campanha').item.json.id }}' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

parameters.jsCode:
// === CONSTRUIR PROMPT (enxuto) === o LLM apenas interpreta; nada de cálculo aqui.
  const d = $input.first().json;
  const ctx = d.strategic_context;
  const sm = ctx.strategic_metrics;
  const lines = [
    'Você é um Analista Político Estratégico Sênior. Os números abaixo JÁ foram calculados pelo sistema.',
    'Sua função é INTERPRETAR e produzir inteligência acionável — não recalcule nem invente dados.',
    '',
    'CAMPANHA: ' + ctx.campaign_summary.name + ' | Candidato: ' + (ctx.campaign_summary.candidate || 'N/A') + ' | Região: ' + (ctx.campaign_summary.region || 'N/A'),
    '',
    'SCORES ESTRATÉGICOS (0-100):',
    '- Overall: ' + sm.overall_intelligence_score + ' | Risk: ' + sm.risk_score + ' | Crisis: ' + sm.crisis_score + ' | Popularity: ' + sm.popularity_score,
    '- Momentum: ' + sm.momentum_score + ' | Opportunity: ' + sm.opportunity_score + ' | Attack: ' + sm.attack_score,
    '- Narrative: ' + sm.narrative_score + ' | Trust: ' + sm.trust_score,
    '',
    'ESTATÍSTICAS 24h: total=' + ctx.statistics.total_mentions + ' | pos=' + ctx.statistics.sentiment_ratio.positive + '% neu=' + ctx.statistics.sentiment_ratio.neutral + '% neg=' + ctx.statistics.sentiment_ratio.negative + '%',
    'TENDÊNCIA: volume ' + ctx.trend_analysis.volume_change_pct + '% | negativo ' + ctx.trend_analysis.negative_change_pp + 'pp | trend=' + ctx.trend_analysis.sentiment_trend + (ctx.trend_analysis.has_baseline ? '' : ' (sem baseline histórico)'),
    '',
    'TEMAS EM ALTA: ' + (ctx.trend_analysis.themes_rising.map(t => t.tema + '(+' + t.delta + ')').join(', ') || 'nenhum'),
    'TEMAS EM QUEDA: ' + (ctx.trend_analysis.themes_falling.map(t => t.tema + '(' + t.delta + ')').join(', ') || 'nenhum'),
    'TOP TEMAS: ' + (ctx.top_topics.map(t => t.tema + ' (' + t.count + ', neg=' + t.negative + ')').join('; ') || 'nenhum'),
    'TOP ENTIDADES: ' + (ctx.top_entities.map(e => (e.entity_name || '?') + ' [' + (e.entity_type || '?') + '] ' + e.count + ' (neg=' + e.negative + ')').join('; ') || 'nenhuma'),
    '',
    'PRINCIPAIS NOTÍCIAS:',
    (ctx.top_news.map(n => '- [' + n.sentiment.toUpperCase() + '] ' + n.title + ' | ' + n.source_name + ' | impacto ' + n.impact_score).join('\n') || 'nenhuma'),
    '',
    'ALERTAS RECENTES: ' + ((ctx.recent_alerts || []).map(a => '[' + (a.severity || '').toUpperCase() + '] ' + a.title).join('; ') || 'nenhum'),
    '',
    'Retorne APENAS JSON válido (sem markdown) nesta estrutura EXATA:',
    '{',
    '  "summary": "resumo executivo 3-5 frases",',
    '  "sentiment_analysis": { "overview": "", "trend": "growing_positive|stable|growing_negative|critical", "critical_points": [] },',
    '  "themes_rising": [ { "theme": "", "reason": "", "urgency": "low|medium|high|critical" } ],',
    '  "themes_falling": [ { "theme": "", "reason": "" } ],',
    '  "risks": [ { "risk": "", "probability": "low|medium|high", "impact": "low|medium|high|critical", "mitigation": "" } ],',
    '  "opportunities": [ { "opportunity": "", "potential": "low|medium|high", "action": "" } ],',
    '  "adversary_movements": [ { "entity": "", "movement": "", "threat_level": "low|medium|high|critical" } ],',
    '  "narrative_changes": [ { "old_narrative": "", "new_narrative": "", "implication": "" } ],',
    '  "crisis_alerts": [ { "description": "", "severity": "low|medium|high|critical", "action_required": "", "deadline_hours": 24 } ],',
    '  "insights": [ "" ],',
    '  "recommendations": [ { "action": "", "reason": "", "urgency": "low|medium|high|critical", "deadline_hours": 48 } ],',
    '  "agenda_suggestions": [ { "title": "", "reason": "", "urgency": "low|medium|high|critical", "engagement_potential": "low|medium|high", "target_audience": "", "suggested_narrative": "", "recommended_tone": "" } ],',
    '  "top_entities": [ { "name": "", "type": "candidate|opponent|party|influencer|portal", "mentions": 0, "sentiment_trend": "positive|neutral|negative", "relevance": "high|medium|low" } ]',
    '}'
  ];
  return [{ json: Object.assign({}, d, { openai_prompt: lines.join('\n') }) }];

values.content: Você é um analista político estratégico sênior. Interprete os indicadores já calculados e retorne SEMPRE JSON válido sem markdown.
